$comment: The source of sf-toast's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/toast (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

status.summary: What the message reports, in the shared status vocabulary. The words this component used before — default and primary — are still accepted and mean neutral and info.

supporting-text.summary: Concise supporting text at the normal body size.

action-text.summary: Visible label of the first optional action, always a button (owner decision C126 (1)): with action-href and no secondary action the button is a link to that address (owner decision C50).

action.summary: Stable action value emitted in sf-toast-action.

action-href.summary: An address for the one light navigation action («Открыть», «Посмотреть», «Подробнее»): with it and without a secondary action, the action button is a link to it (an <a> in the button's classes, in the action's place), followed as a link and reported in sf-toast-action (owner decisions C50, C126 (1): every action is a button; a link in the text is help only).

secondary-action-text.summary: Visible label of a second action: both actions are buttons under the text, and action-href does not apply (C46, C50).

secondary-action.summary: Stable secondary action value emitted in sf-toast-action.

actions-layout.summary: Where the action stands: auto puts it in the row with the text while the toast is wide enough and under the text when narrower (layout L3a); under keeps it under the text at every width, for a long text. Any other word is auto.

closable.summary: Render an explicitly named close action.

close-label.summary: Localized accessible name of the close action. Empty: the text of the page's language ("Close message" in English).

duration.summary: Explicit lifetime in milliseconds. Zero keeps the message until dismissed.

action.summary: data-action or data-toast-action of the pressed control; empty when neither is set.
Emitted once when the optional enabled action is activated.

close.summary: Emitted once before token-based dismissal removes the toast owner.
Same as dismiss: emits sf-toast-close and removes the toast.

show.x-summary: Says a message: text (or the assembly's word for code and count, §11.2) becomes the heading, tone the status

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: role is the host's role attribute when it says status or alert, written on the toast's root; without one the toast is a plain group inside the notification region, which announces

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-toast for the shim (core/js/aliases.js, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (setting rows), host-attribute (no shim), manifest-only (the DOM name does not change).

rows.summary: Legacy name for status, still honoured. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

rows.note: stays a host attribute, read by the toast (status or alert) and written on its root; no shim
the DOM name stays; detail keeps action and loses the elements toast and trigger
rows.summary: Emitted once when the optional enabled action is activated.

rows.note: the DOM name stays and is cancelable now; detail is {reason}, without the elements toast and trigger
rows.summary: Emitted once before token-based dismissal removes the toast owner.

x-summary: Transient overlay feedback with semantic roles, optional action, pause-safe lifetime and dismiss behavior.
x-renamed: settings.title → heading: "title" is a property of HTMLElement.prototype (§3.1, §16 item 26), alias dated
settings.type → status: the axis's old name, alias dated
settings.role: a host attribute, read by the base, never a setting (§3.1)

events sf-toast-action, sf-toast-close: the DOM names stay; detail carries data only (action, reason), the elements toast and trigger leave it (§8); close is a cancelable request and closed the fact (§19.3)
x-decisions: own-verb-words: action is a verb of the toast alone (the person pressed the toast's action button); its word is lang events.action.label.
version: 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: title and type are dated aliases, close becomes cancelable, closed and show are added.
a11y-role: the toast takes the host's role attribute when it is status or alert and writes it on its root; without it the notification region that holds the toast announces (SF.notify).
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows.
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json and studio.scenario.json plus the statuses, an action and a timed toast; probe.json drives the close and action buttons and Tab.
css-variables: the eight public variables the sheet already reads (src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json).

side-effects: none. sf-toast draws where it stands; the toast layer of the one stack is the notification region SF.notify places it in (core/js/notify.js, kind toast: it takes no keys and no presses).

events: the shared class toast (component/toast/js/_toast.js) sends sf-toast-close and sf-toast-action on its root with the elements in detail; sf-toast stops them at its host and sends its own from the host with data only. The class close is cancelable now, so a refused sf-toast-close keeps the toast. Reasons: close (its own close button), api (dismiss(), close(), the timer).
show: an assembly's rule says a message through the toast: text (the word of code and count, §11.2) becomes the heading and tone the status.
version 1.1.1: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.2: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.
version 1.1.7: the outcomes applied and refused come from core/js/element-manifest.js (core.runtime 1.25.0, duplication audit A-26) instead of a copy of its own; behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.9 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The generated reference gives the action's method its one object argument, show({text, code, count, tone}), where it read the parameters one by one (standard §4.4: the parameters arrive as one object); the element's code also takes the value alone, show(<string>), and the reference says so (x-registry.action-calls). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.10 (2026-11-09): a patch, nothing drawn or done differently. The show action's text, code, count and tone are each optional, as the element reads them (show() and show({text}) both apply), so the reference no longer calls show's argument or its four fields required. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.11: an info toast reads the information palette's container, its ink and its graphic tone (--sf-info-container, --sf-on-info-container, --sf-on-info-container-graphic), as success, warning and error read theirs (C17 info parity, dispatcher 2026-11-09; component.toast 1.1.0). It read the brand's primary container before, so under a theme of another colour an info toast took that colour. The former word primary draws the same as info.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-10): a patch (component.toast 1.2.4). The status icon is an sf-icon element, as sf-alert draws its own, and the toast asks the Loader for its glyph when it draws (smart/helpers/cycle.js preloadControlIcons, R074). The bare <i class="sf-icon"> it printed was found only by the Loader's page scan, so a toast drawn where the scan does not look -- a data-sf-observer="ignore" region, a shadow root -- kept an empty box for a glyph the page had not asked for (delete beside warning). The toast sheet places the glyph inside the sf-icon (display: contents) and the sf-icon before it is defined, so size, colour and position are unchanged (tests/browser/toast-status-glyph.browser.mjs). Settings, events and keys are unchanged.

version 1.3.0 (2026-11-11): the actions of owner decision C50, the model of SF.Toast.create (component.toast 1.3.0). action-href (a new public name, the <purpose>-href pattern of more-href, prev-href and later-href) turns the one light navigation action into a link at the end of the text, a.sf-toast-link in the text's own ink; secondary-action-text and secondary-action (sf-alert's names) add a second button under the text. With a secondary action both are buttons and action-href does not apply: a toast never mixes a link and buttons. The link and both buttons carry data-action, so sf-toast-action reports which one was pressed; a link with action-href="#" does not jump.

version 1.3.1 (2026-11-12): a patch (component.toast 1.3.1). The link keeps to the last word of the text it ends: a no-break space stands before it where a plain space did, so a full line no longer sends the link alone onto a line of its own (T2, C50 acceptance r3; 72 of 336 toasts). Settings, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.3.1, also (2026-11-12, group build 2026-11-12): nothing drawn or done differently. The no-break space before the link is written into the text's own node (the title's or the supporting text's), not a node of its own: snapshot-first-paint prints a text node of white space alone as one plain space, so the «link» first paint lost its   on the group build. The page DOM is the same text.

version 1.4.0 (written on the branch as 1.3.0; 2026-11-13, owner decisions C114 and C115; component.toast 1.3.0): a minor. The job is a short reply to an action (C114 (1)). An error or a warning never leaves by itself (C114 (6), NS-2): duration is 0 for them whatever the attribute says, here and in the class toast's timer and in SF.notify (they left after 10 s and 8 s). With one action, the action stands in the row with the text from 20rem of the toast's own width (C115, layout L3a: every toast of the notification area), else under the text from its start with an even bottom inset (C114 (5), NS-10). Events and keys unchanged. A new setting actions-layout (owner 2026-11-13, #q-layout-override): auto (the default) is L3a, under keeps the action under the text at every width with the same gap and the even bottom; the template adds the class form sf-toast--actions-under (the class toast takes actionsLayout); any other word is auto, as every enum setting; no alias. Also (C113 follow-up, DEV overlays acceptance 2026-11-13, through component.toast 1.3.0): in the dark theme the action's label and icon under the pointer take the ink family's full step, --sf-alpha-base (white), on the neutral tonal and ghost plates of a toast; the buttons' --sf-on-surface read 4.38:1 hovered and 4.01:1 pressed on a neutral toast (4.43-4.72 pressed on the levels) over the popup place; now tonal 5.64-6.71 hovered and 5.16-6.08 pressed, ghost 5.65-8.06 and 5.17-7.77. The plates keep C113's 12 / 16 / 20; the light theme is unchanged.

version 1.4.0, also (written on the branch as 1.3.2; 2026-11-13, owner decision C126; component.toast 1.3.2; one number above the unreleased 1.3.1 of the group build): a patch. A link in the toast's text is help only («Узнать больше»), every action a button; the link is the text's own ink on every level, underlined at the link weight, the line doubled under the pointer, its keyboard ring the same ink (core mix/_mix__notice-link.scss, shared with sf-alert and sf-alert-bar). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0, also (written on the branch as 1.3.3; 2026-11-13, owner decision C105 H4/H6, spacing audit O1; component.toast 1.3.3): a patch. The 1 px border stands inside the inline inset, as the fields' C77 inset: the padding is --sf-space-1 less the border, so the status icon, the letters and the cross stand 16 from the outer edge (compact and phone 12), not 17 (13). The action threshold of C115 stays the whole width (20rem). Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.4.0, also (2026-11-14, group build 3; owner decision C126 (1) over C50's link, the merge note control/evidence/2026-11-13-alert-bar-narrow/toast-merge-note.md): a minor with the two above, the light action changes. The one light navigation action (action-text with action-href, no secondary action) is no longer a.sf-toast-link at the end of the text: it is the one action button (the tonal low button of C110 E) drawn as an <a href> in the button's classes, in the C115 place, with data-action and data-toast-action; action-href="#" still does not jump. The no-break space before the link (1.3.1) goes with it. action-href, secondary-action-text, secondary-action, two actions, the timer pause and the SF.notify stack of C50 are kept; the C126 notice-link rule draws every help link in the text. Settings and events unchanged.

lifetime.persistent: duration=0; required for messages whose action or content must not be missed
lifetime.timed: positive duration; pauses while pointer or keyboard focus is inside the toast
lifetime.dismiss: token motion completes before the visual owner is removed

live_region_guidance.assertive: role=alert only for a newly inserted urgent error
live_region_guidance.polite: role=status for a newly inserted non-urgent result
live_region_guidance.static: omit a live-region role when the toast is present on initial page load

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-toast for concise transient overlay feedback that does not block the current task.
do_not: Do not use Toast for persistent inline guidance; use Alert
Do not auto-dismiss a message whose content or action must not be missed
Do not use role=alert for routine success feedback
Do not choose a semantic type only for its color
Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-toast status="success" title="Saved" supporting-text="Your changes are available." role="status" close-label="Close message"></sf-toast>

accessibility.focus: Native actions use focus-visible; a timed toast pauses while focus is inside it.

setState.summary: Writes each key as its kebab-case attribute: false, null, undefined or empty removes it, true sets it empty, anything else is stringified.

onAction.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-action; the handler is called with (action, detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

onClose.summary: Adds a listener for sf-toast-close; the handler is called with (detail, event). Ignores a non-function handler.

role.description: Live-region role for dynamically inserted feedback only.
